message: No detected input validation: The code loads the CSV directly with pandas and applies text cleaning, but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, null-value guards, or value-range validations on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: The dataset is read from a local file path (MODEL_DATA_PATH = './dataset/imdb.csv') with no checksum verification, and there is no remote fetch from any URL or cloud storage in the visible code.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only applies pd.get_dummies() to convert sentiment labels without validating label values against an expected set or checking for label distribution anomalies.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The prepare_data function only performs text cleaning and tokenization with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains a new model from scratch and saves it via ModelCheckpoint, but there is no loading of pretrained weights or serialized models with any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.

No detected label distribution validation: The code applies label encoding via pd.get_dummies but never checks class balance, expected label sets, or flags anomalous sample distributions before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Keras/TensorFlow training with no imports or usage of TensorFlow Privacy, Opacus, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train_test_split is used, there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected output bounds checks: The visible code contains no checks on model output probabilities, NaN guards, or threshold validation before returning predictions.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a sentiment-analysis LSTM (not a generative LLM), and there are no prompt-injection filters, system-prompt isolation, or jailbreak detection mechanisms in the code.
